title: Summoner: golems that guard
changes: Bound golem: outside the safe zone, a Summoner with no golem gets one by itself after 5 seconds, from level 1.
Stone Bond: your nearest golem takes 30% of every blow aimed at you. The Summoner has a bit more life too.
Monsters now turn on the golem fighting them, even when the Summoner hits them.
Conjured Armour (40% less damage, regen, no stuns) and Conjured Blade (more damage, heals on hit) last longer and come back sooner.
